# Migration (PowerMax 10.3)

> Source: Dell's Unisphere for PowerMax OpenAPI spec, **PowerMax 10.3**, as published in github.com/dell/PyU4V (`PyU4V/tools/openapi.json`, Apache-2.0, see NOTICE.md). Everything here is `[doc]` for **this API version**. Check the server with `GET /univmax/restapi/version` first.

## GET `/103/mobility/capabilities/symmetrix`

**Tier:** T0  

Capability checker to see if data migrations will execute on the Systems. Migration is capability checked for source & target capability and some additional features, usually dependent on the microcode version and version of the management software.

**Responses:** `200` OK → `dmStorageArrayCapabilityList` · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `500` Internal Server Error

## GET `/103/mobility/symmetrix`

**Tier:** T0  

Get the list of Systems that are data migration capable.

**Responses:** `200` OK → `dmStorageArrayList` · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `500` Internal Server Error

## POST `/103/mobility/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/storagegroup/{storageGroupId}`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Create a data migration for a Storage Group to another System. Options for the migration type can be entered in the request body object.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | The System ID |
| `storageGroupId` | path | string | yes | The Storage Group name |

**Request body** (required): `migrationCreate`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `executionOption` | string (enum: `SYNCHRONOUS`, `ASYNCHRONOUS`) |  |
| `otherArrayId` | string | The System ID for the target of the migration |
| `srpId` | string | The name of the migration session target System SRP. |
| `portGroupId` | string | The name of the migration session target System port group. |
| `noCompression` | boolean | Create the target Storage Group without compression. Only supported when the target System and SRP support compression. |
| `preCopy` | boolean | Create the migration using the precopy option. Only supported when both the source and target System support create with precopy. |
| `offline` | boolean | Userd to create a minimally disruptive migration |
| `moveIdentity` | boolean | The same device identities as used to access the devices on the source System will be used by the target System devices. |
| `validate` | boolean | Just run the validation to see if the Migration can be created. Don't actually run the create itself. |

**Responses:** `201` Created → `migrationStorageGroup` · `202` Accepted · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `409` Conflict · `500` Internal Server Error

## DELETE `/103/mobility/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/storagegroup/{storageGroupId}`

**Tier:** T3  

This call terminates a migration of a Storage Group. The state of a migration may impact if a migration can be cancelled or not.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | TheSystem ID |
| `storageGroupId` | path | string | yes | The Storage Group name |
| `revert` | query | string |  | Set the revert flag |
| `symforce` | query | string |  | Set the symforce flag |
